name: Jaipur
summary: Two-player trading duel where merchants take and sell goods from a shared market for valuable tokens.
rules_text: Two players compete for Seals of Excellence. Setup 5 cards: 3 camel cards form the market center, plus 2 face-up goods from the deck; each player gets 5 cards, camels go to their herd. Goods tokens are sorted by type descending; bonus tokens are shuffled by size (3,4,5 cards). On your turn do one action: TAKE or SELL. Take options: take 1 goods card from market to hand; OR take all camels from market to your herd; OR exchange 2+ cards: take any number of goods from market then return same number of cards from hand and/or herd. Hand limit 7. Market refills to 5 from deck after taking. SELL: discard 1 type of goods from hand. For diamonds, gold, silver you must sell at least 2. Take that many top tokens of that type, plus one random bonus token if you sold 3+ cards. Round ends when 3 goods token piles are empty or deck runs out while refilling market. Most camels gets 5 rupee camel token. Sum tokens including hidden bonus values; highest total wins a Seal. First to 2 Seals wins.
rating_reason: Two-player set collection trading, hidden hand, sequential choice, strategic.
